valuation.terminalShareInterpretation: Ratio of terminal PV to signed positive operating EV; may exceed one when explicit FCFF PV is negative.

valuation.nullOutputExplanation: Equity/per-share bridge not computed by this operating builder. Company-specific material claims and valuation-date uncertainties are described in the linked register; conditional operating value remains available.

economicPeakDeficit.basis: Peak cumulative undiscounted economic FCFF deficit since forecast year 1. Excludes starting cash, financing, debt service and reserves; scenario outcome, never an added debt deduction.

funding.treatment: Scenario deficit is already in FCFF. Never add it to debt or deduct it again from operating EV. Financing proceeds are not operating income.

boundedModelGaps: Valuation-date stub and post-anchor cash/claims/share roll-forward not integrated; this is a forecast-origin operating EV, not October 17 equity value.
